g.id: elem_3. Promoted from train (timestamp audit required)

g.text: 1. One L2 enrichment pass per source dataset — covers ALL 25 training heads simultaneously.
2. Global split_type applies to ALL heads at once — no per-head leakage (shared backbone).
3. Reserved pool (~88% at construction) = preferred OOD source, never seen by model.
4. Frozen val/test assignments enable cross-model and cross-dataset metric comparison.
5. sha256 primary key prevents duplicate images receiving different split assignments.
